display.title: Apotheosis: Socketed Power
display.subtitle: Acquire a Gem
description: Apotheosis overhauls enchanting and adds the affix + gem-socket system.
Find a §dGem§r, cut it at a Salvaging/Reforging table, and socket it into
gear with an open slot for a permanent bonus.
§7Affixed and socketed gear is how you push past the tiers' rising danger.
